ety.hint: A man 十 bridging heaven and earth (both 一)

origin.says: A drawing of a big battle-axe blade standing edge down, a sign of royal power: king. The old idea of three lines (heaven, man, earth) joined by one is a later explanation.

王.name: king
王.in: 全程望班狂呈皇弄润琴框凰煌旺逛斑噩痊枉逞汪眶筐闰栓惶拴瑟蝗

付.def: give, deliver, pay, hand over; entrust

ety.hint: To hand 寸 something over to someone 亻

origin.says: 亻 (person) plus 寸 (hand): a hand passing something to a person, 'to hand over, to pay'.

付.name: pay

背.def: back, backside; to betray, to violate

origin.says: 北 (north, once 'back') as the sound plus ⺝ (flesh) for the meaning: the back of the body, written apart once 北 meant north; also to turn away, betray.

背.name: back

析.def: to split wood; to divide, to break apart

ety.hint: Chopping 斤 wood 木; 斤 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 木 (wood) plus 斤 (axe): to split wood with an axe, hence to divide and analyse.

析.name: split wood

origin.says: 女 (woman) for the meaning plus 昏 (dusk) as the sound: marriage, said to be held at dusk in old times.

遇.def: to meet, to encounter, to come across

origin.says: 辶 (walk) for the meaning plus 禺 (monkey-like creature) as the sound: to come across someone on the road, to meet, to encounter.

遇.name: meet

ety.hint: To clear 了 an illness 疒; 了 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: Simplified from 療: 疒 (sickness) for the meaning plus 尞 (bonfire) as the sound: to treat an illness, to cure. The sound part was replaced by the simpler 了 (finished).

ety.hint: A strong  巩 bamboo ⺮ building; ⺮ also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 竹 (bamboo) as the sound plus 巩 (to hold) for the meaning: a struck lute. Simplification also uses it for 築 (to build), which added 木 (wood); the 木 was dropped.

ety.hint: A net 罒 of wrongdoing 非

origin.says: 罒 (net) plus 非 (wrong): first a fishing net, then used for 'crime' in place of an older character that looked too much like 皇 (emperor). One reading takes 非 as the sound only.
From 鄉: two people kneeling face to face over a food vessel, a shared feast; the sense moved to 'village, home town'. The simplified form keeps only a shortened left part.

激.def: to arouse, to incite; acute, sharp; fierce, violent

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 敫 (shining) as the sound: water dashing against rocks, hence to stir up, fierce.

激.name: surge

origin.says: 女 (woman) for the meaning plus 某 (a certain) as the sound: the woman who arranges marriages, a go-between; later any medium.

ety.hint: A man 大 wearing a coming-of-age hairpin 一

origin.says: A variant of 大 (a standing grown person) with an extra stroke at the head: a grown man, husband. Tradition reads the stroke as an adult's hairpin; another view calls that a later guess.
Simplified from 陸: 阝 (mound) for the meaning plus 坴 (clods of earth) as the sound: high dry land. The simple form replaced 坴 with 击 (strike).

述.def: to express, to state; to narrate, to tell

origin.says: 辶 (walking) for the meaning plus 朮, now written 术, as the sound: to follow along, then to tell over, to narrate.

述.name: narrate

ety.hint: The ten 十 movements of a piece of music 音

origin.says: One reading sees a chisel (now 立 (stand)) cutting into a piece of jade (now the 日 (sun) part of 早 (early)): working jade into a pattern, so an emblem, a seal, a section of writing. Other sources call the origin unclear.

困.def: to surround; to besiege; surrounded, in distress; poor; tired, sleepy

ety.hint: A fence 囗 built around a tree 木

origin.says: 木 (tree) shut inside 囗 (enclosure): something hemmed in, trapped, in distress. 'Sleepy' comes from 睏 (with 目 (eye)), merged into 困 in simplification.

困.name: trapped tree

减.def: to decrease, to subtract, to diminish

origin.says: From 減: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 咸 (all, also 'to seal') as the sound: sealing off a stream so its flow shrinks, 'to decrease'. The modern form writes 冫 (ice) for 氵.

减.name: subtract

origin.says: Simplified from 腦: 月 (flesh) plus a right side drawing hair (巛) above 囟 (the soft spot on a baby's skull): the brain. The simplified form replaces the right side with the shorthand 㐫.

毕.def: to finish, to conclude, to end; completed

origin.says: Simplified from 畢, a hunting net in a 田 (field), later meaning finish. The new form puts 比 (compare) on top for the sound and keeps 十 (ten), a remnant of the old net's bottom.

毕.name: complete

origin.says: Traditional 礎: 石 (stone) for the meaning plus 楚 (clear) as the sound: the stone under a pillar, a foundation. The simplified form replaced the sound part with 出 (go out).

养.def: to raise, to rear, to bring up; to support

origin.says: Simplified from 養: 羊 (sheep) as the sound over 食 (food) for the meaning: to feed, to rear. In the new form the top lost its tail and 食 became a 介-like bottom.

养.name: raise

换.def: to change; to exchange, to swap, to trade

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 奂 as the sound: passing things from hand to hand, to exchange, to swap. Simplified from 換 (奐 to 奂).

换.name: swap

测.def: to survey, to measure; to estimate, to conjecture

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 則 (rule) as the sound: to measure the depth of water, then to measure in general. Simplified from 測 by writing 貝 as 贝.

测.name: depth gauge

origin.says: A drawing of a feather or tuft of hair: hair, fur, feathers.

ety.hint: Picture of a cross-shaped house or temple

origin.says: Simplified from 亞, a picture of a cross-shaped building seen from above, likely a tomb. It was borrowed for second, inferior; now also for Asia.
纟 (silk) for the meaning plus 囟 (fontanelle) as the sound: thin as silk thread. The sound part was miswritten as 田 (field) after the Han dynasty; simplified from 細 (糸 → 纟).

ety.hint: Five elements (the cross with the extra stroke) between heaven 一 and earth 一

origin.says: Oldest forms are an X between two lines (earlier just an X); what it pictured is debated (a tally mark, crossing). It has meant five since the oracle bones.

降.def: to descend, to fall; to drop, to lower

origin.says: 阝 (hill, on the left) plus 夅 (two feet pointing down) as sound and meaning: feet coming down a hill, to descend, to lower.

降.name: descend

origin.says: Simplified from 獎: 將 (to lead) as the sound plus 犬 (dog); the sound part was cut to its simplified top (⺦ + 夕) and 犬 became 大 (big). Why a dog is unclear; perhaps urging a dog on.

编.def: to knit, to weave; to arrange, to compile

origin.says: 纟 (thread) for the meaning plus 扁 (flat) as the sound: tying bamboo slips together with thread, hence to weave, compile, edit. Simplified from 編 (糹 → 纟).

编.name: compile

签.def: to sign, to endorse; a note, a slip of paper

origin.says: 𥫗 (bamboo) for the meaning plus 佥 (all) as the sound: a bamboo slip, then to sign. It stands for both 簽 (to sign) and 籤 (bamboo slip, with a different sound part).

签.name: signature

origin.says: 广 (building) for the meaning plus 占 (divine) as the sound: a shop or inn. A relatively late character.

防.def: to protect, to defend, to guard against

origin.says: 阝 (mound, wall) for the meaning plus 方 (square) as the sound: an earth dyke or embankment, then to guard against, defend.

防.name: defend

落.def: to fall, to drop; surplus, net income

origin.says: 艹 (plants) for the meaning plus 洛 (Luo river) as the sound: leaves falling from plants, to fall, to drop.

落.name: fall

歌.def: song, lyrics; to sing, to chant

origin.says: 哥 (once 'to sing') as the sound plus 欠 (open mouth, breath) for the meaning: breathing out a tune, a song.

歌.name: song

origin.says: One reading: a mark added to 牙 (teeth, interlocking), and early texts swap the two; another sees two hooks catching each other: mutual, each other.
𠂢 was a picture of a river splitting into branches; 氵 (water) was added later. A branch of a river became a branch of people: faction, school; also to send off.

练.def: to drill, to exercise; to practice, to train

origin.says: Simplified from 練: 糸 (silk) for the meaning plus 柬 (pick out) as the sound; both parts take cursive short forms. First 'to boil and soften raw silk', then to work something over and over: to practise.

练.name: drill

origin.says: The old 華 drew a plant in bloom, hence flourishing and splendid, later China. The 1956 simplification replaced its top with 化 (change) as a sound part and kept 十 from the bottom stalk.

ety.hint: To stop someone 止 with an arrow 弋

origin.says: 戈 (dagger-axe) over 止 (foot): marching with weapons, an army on campaign, hence military. The old reading 'stopping weapons' is a later moralising guess. In the modern shape the 戈 is pulled apart into a stroke plus 弋 (stake).

销.def: to fuse, to melt; to market, to sell

origin.says: 金 (metal) for the meaning plus 肖 as the sound: to melt metal, hence to cancel, and to sell off. Simplified from 銷 (金 written 钅).

销.name: sell

ety.hint: A man standing with arrows pointing to his armpits

origin.says: A person standing with arms out, 大 (big man), with two marks at the armpits: first 'armpit' (now 腋). It was borrowed for the like-sounding 'also'.

努.def: to exert, to strive, to make an effort; to pout

origin.says: 力 (strength) for the meaning plus 奴 (slave) as the sound, with a hint of toil: to exert oneself, to strive.

努.name: strive

origin.says: Simplified from 課: 言 (speech) for the meaning plus 果 (fruit) as the sound, with 言 written 讠: to test or assess, then a set task, a lesson, a class.
言 (speech) for the meaning plus 吳 (shouting man) as the sound: to speak wrongly, a mistake. Simplified as 讠 and 吴.

ety.hint: Simplified form of 層; 曾 provides the pronunciation

origin.says: Simplified from 層: 尸 (a house) for the meaning plus 曾 as the sound: a house with stories piled up, a layer. The simplified form replaces 曾 with 云.

ety.hint: A cow 牛 splitting 丷 wood in half

origin.says: 八 (to divide) over 牛 (cow): a cow cut into two halves, hence half. The two parts have merged, with strokes crossing, into one shape.
𠂇 is a drawing of a left hand; 工 (work, tool) was added later for the sense 'to help'. The character then kept 'left', and 'help' moved to 佐.

油.def: oil, fat, grease, lard; oil paints

origin.says: 氵 (liquid) for the meaning plus 由 (from) as the sound: first the name of a river, later oil and grease.
origin.src: Wiktionary; Dong Chinese; own knowledge for the river

油.name: oil

卖.def: to sell; to betray; to show off

origin.says: Simplified from 賣: 出 (go out) over 買 (buy): letting goods go out, to sell. 出 shrank to 士 and then to 十, and 買 became 买.

卖.name: vend

origin.says: Traditional 購: 貝 (shell, money) for the meaning plus 冓 (framework) as the sound: to buy. Simplified to 贝 and 勾 (hook).
From 沖: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 中 (middle) as the sound, water that rinses or gushes. The simplified form writes 冫 (ice) for 氵 and also takes over 衝 (to charge, dash).
Origin unclear. One reading sees a huge snake, another a person reaching out to grab and cling to something. Today it is used mostly for its sound.

巴.name: cling
巴.in: 把吧爸肥爬芭疤邑耙靶

审.def: to examine, to investigate; to judge; to try

origin.says: The traditional 審 was 宀 (roof) over 番 (with 釆, distinguish): examining things closely indoors. The simplified form replaced 番 with 申 (extend), which gives the sound.

审.name: trial

ety.hint: A silken thread 糸 hanging off a tree 龶

origin.says: 糸 (silk thread) below a top part that may be hands working the thread: raw undyed silk, hence white, plain, vegetarian. The top now looks like 龶.

败.def: failure; to decline, to fail, to suffer defeat

origin.says: Simplified from 敗: 贝 (shell, money) as the sound plus 攵 (to strike) for the meaning. Striking something breaks it, and 'to break' narrowed to 'to be defeated, to fail'. 貝 became 贝.

败.name: defeat

顾.def: to look back; to look at; to look after

origin.says: Simplified from 顧: 雇 (hire) as the sound plus 頁 (head) for the meaning: to turn the head and look back, to look after. The simple form replaced 雇 with 厄 (distress).

顾.name: look back

率.def: to command, to lead; rate, ratio, proportion

ety.hint: A string 幺 vibrating in an instrument 亠十

origin.says: A drawing of a rope (the middle, like 幺 thread) with dots of fibres on both sides; one old reading sees a bird net on a pole. Rope used to lead, hence 'to lead', and later 'rate'.

率.name: lead rope

缺.def: to lack, to be short; vacancy, gap, deficit

origin.says: 缶 (earthen pot) for the meaning plus 夬 (parting) as the sound: a chipped pot, hence 'to lack, a gap'.

缺.name: cracked pot

刻.def: to carve, to engrave; a quarter hour; a moment

origin.says: 亥 (twelfth branch) as the sound plus 刂 (knife) for the meaning: to carve, to engrave; from the notches on a water clock, a quarter hour, a moment.

刻.name: carve

ety.hint: Dominating a woman 女 by force of arms 戈

origin.says: 戌 (axe, armed force) plus 女 (woman): power that inspires awe. One explanation sees in 女 the household authority of a mother-in-law; the exact idea is uncertain.

ety.hint: Someone 亻 who can build 建 things; 建 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 亻 (person) for the meaning plus 建 (build) as the sound: a person who is solidly built, strong and healthy.

趣.def: interest; interesting; what attracts one's attention

origin.says: 走 (walk) for the meaning plus 取 (take) as the sound: hurrying toward something that draws you, hence 'interest, fun'.

趣.name: interest

ety.hint: Everyone 並 under the sun 日

origin.says: 並 (side by side) over 日 (sun): the sun shining on all things alike, widespread, general. Some sources take 並 as the sound.

救.def: aid, help; to rescue, to save

origin.says: 攵 (hand with a stick, action) for the meaning plus 求 (seek) as the sound: to act to help someone, to rescue.

救.name: rescue

origin.says: 礻 (altar) for the meaning plus 畐 (full jar) as the sound and sense: blessings from the spirits, good fortune.
Simplified from 階: 阝 (hill, steps) for the meaning plus 皆 (all) as the sound, swapped for the simpler 介 (go-between), also a sound part: stairs, rank.
A drawing of a long river with its side streams, hence 'long, forever'. Another reading sees a person swimming in water, the original of 泳 (swim).
灬 (fire) for the meaning plus 列 (row) as the sound: a fierce, blazing fire; violent, ardent.

博.def: to gamble, to play games; to win; rich, plentiful, extensive; wide, broad

origin.says: 十 (ten, all) for the meaning plus 尃 (spread out) as the sound: broad, extensive, wide knowledge.

博.name: broad learning

origin.says: Merges 鐘 (bell: 金 metal + 童 child as the sound) and 鍾 (wine cup: 金 metal + 重 heavy as the sound). The simplified form is 钅 (metal) plus 中 (middle) as the sound.
From 雜: 衣 (clothing) for the meaning plus 集 (gather) as the sound: cloth of many colours put together, mixed. The simplified form writes 衣 like 九 (nine) and keeps only 木 (tree) from 集.

征.def: to summon, to recruit; levy, tax; journey; invasion

origin.says: 彳 (step) for the meaning plus 正 (upright) as the sound: to march on a campaign, the first sense of 正 (upright). It also took over 徵 (summon, levy) in simplification.

征.name: campaign

origin.says: 讠 (speech) for the meaning plus 司 (manage) as the sound: words, a phrase or expression. Simplified from 詞 (言 to 讠).
口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 拉 (pull) as the sound: a spoken sentence-final particle.

辑.def: to gather, to collect; to edit, to compile

origin.says: Simplified from 輯: 车 (cart) for the meaning plus 咠 (whisper) as the sound: first the parts of a cart fitted together, then to gather and edit. The cart 車 became 车.

辑.name: edit

攻.def: to accuse; to assault; to criticize

origin.says: 工 (work) as the sound plus 攵 (a hand with a stick, strike) for the meaning: to attack, also to work hard at something.

攻.name: attack

红.def: red, vermillion; to blush, to flush; popular

origin.says: 纟 (silk) for the meaning plus 工 (work) as the sound: silk of a light red dye, then red. Simplified from 紅, with 糸 (silk) in short form.

红.name: red

origin.says: 木 (wood) for the meaning plus 才 (talent) as the sound: timber, and from that any material; the same word as 才, so also natural ability.

肯.def: to agree to, to consent, to permit; ready, willing

ety.hint: To stop 止 flexing one's muscles ⺼

origin.says: Originally meat (肉, now ⺝) still attached to a bone; the bone part was later reshaped into 止 (foot). The meaning willing, to agree is a sound loan.

肯.name: willing

ety.hint: An altar on which a sacrifice is being made

origin.says: Possibly a drawing of a flower's base (the original form of 蒂, stalk), or of bundled wood for a sacrifice; borrowed for the supreme god, then the emperor. The modern shape no longer shows the picture.

射.def: to shoot, to eject, to emit

ety.hint: A bow 身 being drawn by a hand 寸

origin.says: A bow and arrow with a hand (寸 (hand)) drawing the string: to shoot. The bow and arrow later came to be written 身 (body), unrelated.

射.name: shoot

ety.hint: A public 官 building where food 饣 is served; 官 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: Simplified from 館: 食 (food) plus 官 (official) as the sound, a guesthouse where travelling officials were fed and lodged; now any hall or establishment. 食 is written 饣.
